title.label: A better way to age gracefully..

content.label: This 82y/o body has been energized with a consistent, healthy level of exercise protected and monitored by this great app. The “gentle” concept (not exercising like I always had - stressfully) is remarkable for how it fits my life, and the results- lower bp and weight loss) are proof. Get it.
This app keeps me informed about what’s happening in my body. You can make better choices with the right knowledge! It’s a great app to use in your wellness journey.

This app has helped me immensely on my journey. I learned so much by their Path analogy and learning to listen to my body. I appreciate all of the different exercise options that I haven’t seen in other fitness apps or the native Apple apps. It seamlessly syncs to my Apple Health without issues. I haven’t had any issues with the widget or Watch apps. The team makes meaningful updates when needed and takes user feedback into account when making changes. 

I very much recommend this app!

Gentler Streak has become my go-to app for checking my daily activity bar in the morning for a comprehensive understanding of how much effort my body is ready to give in the day. I really enjoy using the workout tracker during live workouts as well because of its constant heart rate display. It truly is a gentler workout app!

I’ve always struggled at times to understand what is considered “pushing” it when working out so it made a lot of sense why I would constantly start and stop because the aftermath of working out to the extreme would be just giving up. Now I can see when my body might be feeling a bit stretched and lets me rest without as much guilt!
This app is encouraging and respectful without ever feeling like it’s crossing a line. I think the designers really understand motivation. Aptly named app.

title.label: Very well-rounded approach to helping me on my fitness journey

content.label: The data and analytics that this app provides is top notch. It takes what is already being provided (Health app) and brings it to a whole new level that I can understand and take action to make myself a healthier and more fit individual. Not only is the content remarkable, but the interface is very attractive and it makes me enjoy using the app that much more. A shout out to the application developers behind this wonderful application!

My fav fitness app. I love the customization and the no pressure way the app helps me keep track of my workouts. Have been using over a year and zero issues on iPhone or iPad. No ads. No in app purchases. Low yearly rate. No regrets!

If you’re tired of chasing ring streaks or burned out on trying to over-optimize your wellness routine, this is the app for you. Not only does it give you more depth to your metrics but it recommends gentler workouts to keep you moving without overdoing it.

I have the paid version of this app, although the free version was good too. I like that it gives me somewhere to aim in terms of my physical activity and it tells me about how I slept last night and monitors my vital signs. There aren’t ads constantly trying to sell me things. Just all around great!!

I couldn’t tell you how many workout trackers I’ve tried over the years but I CAN tell you that this is by far the best one I’ve ever used. The team that put this together actually gets what makes for helpful data and insight that you can really rely on to help create a sensible and sustainable workout routine that works — because it is works not just for FOR you but WITH you. 

And I got this about three or four days in, after both a poor night’s sleep and a pretty strenuous workout, when the app recommended . . . Rest! Or a gentle day of recovery, and suggested light walking. And it explained very simply that proper rest was a vital part of good and sustainable training. And what it DIDN’T do was just read out to me the next day after I would naturally have rested, that I hadn’t met my daily exercise goal. You know: those graphs and data points that simply make you feel like you’re a wimp. 

I could go on. But you just have to try this and use it for a few days and you will see for yourself that it’s made for you and that you’re going to want it with YOU going forward!

I love Gentler Streak! I’ve renewed my premium subscription twice because it helps keep me moving without making me feel guilty or pinging body issues. I let it lapse once, but I came back bc it just genuinely helps me. An excellent app!
Great app to support your health and wellness journey. Keeps you gently accountable and encourages you to stay active. The UI is delightful and inviting. Overall, a joy to use.

I recently got my first Apple Watch mostly for the integrated notifications. The fitness culture that I had seen introduced by many wearables was a major annoyance to me, but I have come to love Gentler Streak. The emphasis on sustainable fitness is something that no other app seems to nail and it has a beautiful way of nudging me to give a little more when I can and helps me understand why I might not be feeling great. I especially love that I can still get insights into my activity without wearing my watch, thanks to step tracking being included in my fitness path, even if I don’t log a workout. If you’re interested in sustainable fitness but have found other fitness apps frustrating or discouraging, give Gentler Streak a try!
it keeps you informed and interested in your health and gives you incentive to do more to improve yourself, thank you Gentler

title.label: Fitness Motivation for Real Humans, not Machines 😁

content.label:
Gentler Streak is exactly what its name promises—and that alone makes it stand out in a crowded fitness app space.

What I love most is the tone: friendly, kind, and genuinely encouraging. So many fitness apps push a harsh “do everything or fail” mentality that feels designed for professional athletes, not real people. Gentler Streak understands that many of us are just normal humans trying to move our bodies more consistently, without guilt or burnout. It feels like a supportive companion, not a drill sergeant.

The app is incredibly easy to use, with clear visuals and thoughtful insights that actually make sense. The Apple Watch integration is especially excellent—focused, clean, and informative without being distracting. I appreciate the gentle notes and context around activity levels; they help me understand my body instead of judging it.

Small touches really add up here: intuitive design, meaningful streaks that don’t punish you, and a philosophy that values sustainability over extremes. It’s motivating in a quiet, reassuring way that keeps me coming back.

If you’ve ever bounced off fitness apps because they felt overwhelming, aggressive, or unrealistic, Gentler Streak is absolutely worth trying. It’s fitness encouragement done right.

The first thing I do when I get back from my daily walk is to sit down with my protein drink and go to the Gentler Streak app to see the stats. I like to see how long I stayed in each level so I can see what zones my efforts throughout the walk put me in. I like that it maps my route and I love the bit of encouragement it gives me.

This is one of the best apps that I have use for health tracking. The encouragement provided by this app helps me to keep focused and building. The best part to me is the way the app reminds me to take a break from the workout routine and that alone helps prevent burnout. The lifetime membership is an excellent price for what you get. Can’t say enough good things about this app. It says what it does and does what it says!

Love this app. Well designed, thoughtful, and impactful.  Seems like Apple agrees  because they copied some elements of what GS does by adding Training Load. But Gentler Streak presents the info so much better than the Fitness App. I check it every morning and it helps me plan my day. Also noticed that for every one alcoholic beverage my sleeping heart rate went up by 5%. I used to think one drink didn’t have an impact but I’ve since dropped most alcohol and feel way better.  Thanks, Gentler Streak.
Everything I tap wants money. I’ll just stick with my default app.
A thoughtful and detailed app!

title.label: Has been using for 2 years plus

content.label: Really unique app which fits my needs. Consistency is the key.

title.label: Amazing, but requires user involvement to have real value

content.label:
I’ve been using this app for a couple of years, and it is by far the best fitness tracker I’ve found. I’ve been able use Gentler Streak to find fitness that’s sustainable while managing chronic illness, rather than being pushed to burnout with arbitrary goals. I love that the developers have continued to integrate more health data as it’s become available, and I’m excited to see how the app keeps evolving. 

The only reason I can’t give this app 5 stars is that for non-cardio strength exercise (specifically yoga, for me) the perceived exertion that the app applies is way, way off. Every yoga class I take, the app registers as “extremely light,” even if I’m sweating bullets, can’t regulate my breathing, and my muscles are burning.  If I don’t go in and update that to how hard the session really feels, I would be headed in the wrong direction in a serious way, pushing too hard and going straight into PEM. I can definitely understand why it’s hard to quantify effort with exercise where the difficulty doesn’t have an immediate link to heart rate, and honestly I’m not sure if this is something that really has a fix, but that’s been my only frustration with this app. 

Bottom line, if you are looking for a way to sustainably build fitness (especially if you’re managing fatigue and chronic illness), this app is a life changer; just make sure you’re digging into the details and making sure that the assumptions the app is making are correct.

Okay, I hate that other apps don’t account for vacation, sickness, life and my stats are just like “wow you’re lazy -100% below blah blah” it makes me feel bad for prioritizing rest or life. However gentle streak encourages it. Like the other day I did a lot more miles than i usually do and the app was like hey maybe chill out so your body can heal. Overall 10/10 love
The continue bar just spins and nothing happens.  Tired 2 wifi and 1 cellular connection and no difference
I would love to try this out but because I use Fitbit instead of Apple Watch it’s impossible to sync my data. Disappointing.
None of my weekly recaps are loading. Endless spinner! Bummed.

I got an email today 01/01/2026 to come back to Gentler Streak for 50% off. I click the link, it opens the app, then proceeds to say it's only 40% off.  The most frustrating part is, it says Pay Once, Enjoy Forever!  Ok Great, I am all in!  But read some more, and it says, $17.99 or something close to that, and renews yearly at $29.99. A renewing annual fee, is the opposite of...Pay Once, and Enjoy Forever!!  Gotta jump through hoops to contact them too. It's ridiculous.

I used to really like this app but now I feel that all it does is scold me. If you are someone who is experienced with exercise and in touch with your body, and like to comfortably push yourself sometimes, this app probably isn’t for you. I like to start my week with one intense workout and then the next 4 days I follow with more moderate ones. Lately, I do the intense workout and then the app yells at me and says I’m overdoing it. The next day when I listen to my body and do less intense workouts, it yells at me more and say I need rest, when I KNOW I will get my rest days on the weekend. Basically, don’t use this app if you are already very in tune with your body and recovery.

I love this app and the approach to physical activity feels more encouraging than shaming. Request to developers: Could you add housechores, or allow the user to fill in what the workout activity is, if it's not listed? Depending on what my house chores are for the day, it can break me out in a sweat.

I have had this app for a while now as an annual subscriber but lately it’s useless. Crashed every time I try to look at any thing besides the daily screen. I used to use it to compare my monthly progress and loved the recaps. No more. Won’t open, just crashes. Finally today I got the year end review to load on my third try but it crashed repeatedly when it got to the “how many days you met your body’s needs”.  Not worth it anymore.

Gentler Streak on paper seems like an incredible app fun interface integration with Apple health and features that other apps don’t have but when you compare it not just to other apps but health apps from other companies like Samsung or Fitbit there is nothing revolutionary about it yes the colors and the emojis make it seem more interesting but when you are asked to spend 55 dollars a year on a service that has no AI functionality and nothing organic or original then it makes it seem not really worth it not to mention that its entire concept will be worthless by April of 2026 when apple is expected to introduce its own native health service which will be much cheaper
I’m 12 and I hate the way my body was now I love it and I feel more confident about my body and I love this app so much

I’ve used and loved this app for years, but for the past few months the Gentler Streak watch complication displays completely different data than the iPhone app. My phone tracks my workouts perfectly, but my watch thinks it’s been weeks since I’ve been active. Why one star? Well, I reached out to the developer about the issue, and never heard back. It’s a great app, I just wish it worked. Phone: 17 pro, watch: ultra gen 1
Found this appp . Loving itt - - across alll my devices - but- nothing !!!! Happy as a day
This app helps me to tailor my activities to how my body is doing that day in a way that helps me both be a person with ups and downs and also move toward improving.  Great app!

I’ve been using Gentler Streak off and on for years, but three months ago I finally had to commit to losing at least 25 pounds and achieving a normal BMI. Daily check-ins with this app along with intermittent fasting have been key to my having reached that goal a few days ago, and will be invaluable in helping me maintain this new baseline.

I especially appreciate its tracking my daily steps as well, not just “official” workouts, as there are many days where I’m too busy to take a hike, but have nonetheless done plenty of walking. 

I think that in the past I was guilty of overthinking when and how hard to work out; now I just check the weather and follow Gentler Streak’s suggestions. Essential app for me!
The app is free but does have upgrade options

This is my favorite app to track my workouts. I also like how you can add in chores as an activity. The path that shows if you’ve over worked yourself or not is great. It also tracks sleep, steps and HRV. It’s great. I have the pro version and it’s worth every penny.

Gentler streak played a key role in getting me back into shape after years of a sedentary lifestyle. Now I play tennis almost every day, my blood pressure and better than normal, and I’ve never been fitter. This app is a game changer.
It doesn’t do anything else than the regular fitness app on iphone. Also, free version is bare bone. It’s nice to see more emojis and simplifying interface but 60 dollar a year… I dont’t think so
It doesn’t work.  Promises much; delivers nothing!

I downloaded gentler streak when I started running for fun. Every time I use this app I get so happy it has really helped me see that fitness is an overall weekly thing helps me view a larger picture which I really love because it reminds me that every little thing counts. it also treats working out and resting in such a positive light that it makes it genuinely enjoyable, the cute graphics and interesting statistics are another benefit. If you have struggled with extreme exercising, this is the app for you.

title.label: I can't understand the purpose of this app

content.label: This app aggregates data from the health and workout apps and display them in a nice way. Well the UI is nice so I applaud the developers for making it smoother than iOS default apps. But other than that, what purpose does it serve? I've used it for a week, and the recommendation is always something vague and generic: do exercise if you can otherwise listen to your body. That's something I already know. It doesn't give me any insights I cannot get from the iOS built in apps.

Gentler Streak is my favorite app for tracking sleep, exercise, and daily movement. I've used it for over a year and find it very helpful, even without paid features. I give it four stars because of how it rates sleep. It measures sleep quality well—heart rate, oxygen levels, stages, and respiratory rate—but doesn't focus enough on total sleep. I slept well but only got 5 hours; the app says I am doing great and should push forward, even when exhausted. It’s usually accurate but on days I sleep less (around 5.5 hours, as a college student), it still claims I had great sleep and should keep going; because I got a normal amount of restorative sleep. Overall I still highly recommend this app and its amazing usefulness and ability.

They finally integrated cycle syncing for women and I think it’s a game changer! I love opening the little widget and seeing my phase. I heavily rely on gentler streak to help me
Plan my workouts intuitively, and this integration is going to help a lot. I hope soon it starts to factor into the position of your streak.
It still takes over an hour for workouts that take place outside the app to show up in the app.

It takes FOREVER to load now. Very sad, used to be my favorite subscription app.

It is no longer worth paying for an app that performs this poorly for this long. I don’t think they’re every going to fix what is wrong with the health data syncing, which is why it takes so long to load your sleep metrics and everything else.
